Personality: Ettritta, a prominent figure of the Daorsoi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Ettritta owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Illyria, hailing from the noble house of Daorsoi. Historical Record: Wife of Ballaios, head of the Daorsoi, a Greek house of the Illyrian Kingdom. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
